Definition: Number of sulfur atoms in the standardized RDKit molecular graph
Implementation_basis: Atom symbol == S
Notes: S is one of the target chalcogens

Definition: Number of selenium atoms in the standardized RDKit molecular graph
Implementation_basis: Atom symbol == Se
Notes: Se is one of the target chalcogens

Definition: Number of tellurium atoms in the standardized RDKit molecular graph
Implementation_basis: Atom symbol == Te
Notes: Te is one of the target chalcogens

Definition: Sum of sulfur selenium and tellurium atom counts
Implementation_basis: Sulfur Count + Selenium Count + Tellurium Count
Notes: Oxygen is not included in this target-focused count

Definition: Target chalcogen atoms divided by heavy atom count
Implementation_basis: Target Chalcogen Count / Heavy Atom Count
Notes: Heavy atom denominator is constrained to at least 1 in implementation

Definition: Categorical label describing which target chalcogen elements are present
Implementation_basis: S / Se / Te / Mixed / None
Notes: Mixed indicates more than one of S Se and Te

Definition: Binary flag for presence of more than one target chalcogen element
Implementation_basis: 1 when more than one of S Se Te is present otherwise 0

Definition: Binary presence flag for sulfur
Implementation_basis: 1 when Sulfur Count > 0 otherwise 0

Definition: Binary presence flag for selenium
Implementation_basis: 1 when Selenium Count > 0 otherwise 0

Definition: Binary presence flag for tellurium
Implementation_basis: 1 when Tellurium Count > 0 otherwise 0

Definition: Number of target chalcogen atoms marked aromatic by RDKit
Implementation_basis: GetIsAromatic() for S Se Te atoms

Definition: Number of target chalcogen atoms not marked aromatic
Implementation_basis: Target Chalcogen Count - Aromatic Chalcogen Count

Definition: Number of target chalcogen atoms that belong to at least one ring
Implementation_basis: IsInRing() for S Se Te atoms

Definition: Number of unique bonds connecting a target chalcogen atom to carbon
Implementation_basis: Unique bond traversal around S Se Te atoms
Notes: Each molecular bond is counted once

Definition: Number of unique bonds connecting a target chalcogen atom to a non-carbon non-hydrogen atom
Implementation_basis: Unique bond traversal around S Se Te atoms
Notes: Each molecular bond is counted once

Definition: Count of aromatic neighboring atoms encountered across unique bonds involving target chalcogens
Implementation_basis: Neighbor GetIsAromatic() during unique bond traversal
Notes: Each molecular bond is traversed once

Definition: Number of bonds marked conjugated by RDKit
Implementation_basis: GetIsConjugated()

Definition: Number of aromatic bonds divided by total molecular bond count
Implementation_basis: Aromatic bonds / total bonds
Notes: Total bond denominator is constrained to at least 1

Definition: Number of unique atoms participating in at least one conjugated bond divided by heavy atom count
Implementation_basis: Unique atoms from conjugated bonds / Heavy Atom Count
Notes: Heavy atom denominator is constrained to at least 1

Definition: Number of fully aromatic rings containing at least one non-carbon non-hydrogen atom
Implementation_basis: RDKit AtomRings plus aromaticity checks
Notes: This descriptor is not limited to chalcogen-containing rings

Definition: Binary flag identifying repeated standardized molecular structures within the processed dataset
Implementation_basis: InChIKey when available with canonical SMILES fallback
Notes: Repeated structures are flagged rather than automatically removed
